description: Relation type definitions and validation rules for the CUMCM Award Collection.

relation_types.description: Files with identical SHA-256 hashes. Byte-for-byte identical content.
relation_types.notes: G2 has already identified 75 exact duplicate groups with 166 members.

relation_types.description: Files that are very similar but not byte-identical. May differ in metadata, formatting, or minor edits.
relation_types.determination_method: Content similarity analysis (fuzzy hashing, text comparison, etc.)
relation_types.notes: Requires content analysis. Not performed in G3-00.

relation_types.description: Same intellectual work in different file formats (e.g., PDF and DOCX of same paper).
relation_types.determination_method: Content analysis, metadata matching, filename patterns
relation_types.notes: Example: A paper exists as both .pdf and .docx files.

relation_types.description: Same intellectual work with substantive differences (e.g., draft vs. final, revised edition).
relation_types.determination_method: Content analysis, version detection, metadata comparison
relation_types.notes: Example: A paper has both a draft and final submission version.

entity_types.description: A physical file in the repository.

no_auto_deletion.description: No relation type allows automatic deletion of files.
no_auto_deletion.rule: All files are preserved regardless of relation status.

deterministic_ids.description: All relation IDs must be deterministic and reproducible.
deterministic_ids.rule: No random UUIDs. IDs are computed from entity identifiers.

referential_integrity.description: All references must point to existing entities.
referential_integrity.rule: Foreign keys must reference existing records.

unknown_handling.description: Unknown values are preserved, not guessed.
unknown_handling.rule: Use 'unknown' when information cannot be determined.
